question.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></math> of a non-volatile non-electrolyte solute is disolved in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>200</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></math> of two different solvents <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></math> whose ebullioscopic constants are in the ratio of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo>:</mo><mn>8</mn></math>. The elevation in boiling points of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></math> are in the ratio <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi></mfrac><mfenced><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo>:</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi></mrow></mfenced></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi></math> is____(Nearest Integer)

solution.text:
Given : KbAKbB=18

∴ ΔTBAΔTBB=KbA·mKbB·m=18=xy

∵ xy=18

∴ y=8 (nearest integer)
